exposure: Planned surgery for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
Emergency surgery for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
cohort: The study included 36 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) managed at a single tertiary care hospital in Amritsar.
finding: Women undergoing planned surgery for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) experienced significantly better clinical outcomes, including less perioperative blood loss, fewer blood transfusions, shorter hospital stays, and lower maternal morbidity and mortality rates, compared to those undergoing emergency surgery.
